up: Find all molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1240409. Start by identifying the document in the docs table (chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1240409'). For each molecule appearing in that document, retrieve its ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), maximum development phase (molecule_dictionary.max_phase), molecule type (molecule_dictionary.molecule_type), and canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Use the following join chain: docs → compound_records (on doc_id) → molecule_dictionary (on molregno) → compound_structures (on molregno). Include every molecule even if some of the requested fields are NULL. Sort the final result by the molecule's ChEMBL ID in ascending order. Return all qualifying rows with no arbitrary row limit.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1240409' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
